explication: Proton lets Windows-exclusive games run on Linux using Wine. The supplied tree and excerpts chiefly expose lsteamclient, a Steam API compatibility layer: a game-facing Remote Storage call is adapted to a Steam-client call through generated parameter structures and dispatch macros. The wider game-launch path through Wine is documented, but its implementation is not present in the supplied files. Other Steam API areas and SDK interface versions are represented in the tree; their internal wiring is not established by these excerpts.
